finding.summary: When output_tensors[i].grad_fn is None: `differentiable` is reset to True at the start of every forward (line 313) and AND-ed with each op output's grad_fn. PracticalHybridSearch.__init__ reads this flag after one probe forward, so a single non-differentiable op (or a non-float input) permanently disables the gradient search for the whole model.
